title: 4521-ESP-AGE-74-70-0001 R1 Temperature
summary:
- Engineering specification for the Ullage cleaning system at Solana project.
- Temperature RTD Element with Thermowell and Transmitter is required.
- Revisions are tracked in the body of the specification.
- Confidentiality clause restricts use, reproduction, or disclosure of information.
- Alternate billing cycle allowed by the owner.
- Engineering specification for temperature RTD Element with Thermowell and Transmitter
- All materials must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards
- Vendor must supply all required data and quote times for approval drawings and fabrication
- Equipment to be delivered to purchaser's manufacturing site by August 2012
- List of recommended spare parts with prices and delivery times required
- Inspection by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment
- Vendor invited to quote as an alternate for cost reduction or improved performance
